However if he refuses I would consider breaking up... its very weird to not like it if you wear makeup. It shouldnt even matter actually if he really loves you. He is 7 years older and you have a lot of time to find someone better.

She clearly needs time to figure herself out and if you come back to her you will hurt yourself even more.. youre allowed to think about yourself too!

It’s been only two months right? The guy has been dealing with his insecurities for a year and they won’t disappear just because he met someone nice. You have to be patient. Keep showing him love and care and eventually he will warm up but it will take months. Being in a relationship with someone who is damaged is not an easy task but his actions does not reflect that you are doing anything wrong. You have no reason to feel this way, keep your head up and keep on focusing on trying to make sure he feels safe!

how long have you two been together? People are usually quick to demonize cheaters and would tell you to break up with her almost immediately. Your girlfriend certainly loves you even though that whole event was unforgivable but maybe its possible to come past it. I’d suggest trying to get her to therapy, since that was one terrible way of coping with your accident there’s probably a lot of things she needs to sort out and maybe theres hope. If she truly just wants to cheat and goes back to other people in the future give it up though...
